title: S. D: sua donna. Già: di lui. gelindo risolve di non amare S. D.
html_source: From James McMichael’s “Ulysses and Justice” pg. 120: “S.D.: sua donna,” he worries. The initials are at once [Stephen’s] own and those for the Italian of “his woman."Già: di lui”: sure, his – as if he had one! “Già: di lui. gelindo risolve di non amare”: he who is cold resolves not to love."
